svg.text: Privacy Portal architecture — source chain ↔ COTI: contracts, roles, state and flows
coti-contracts 8a0c4928 · PrivacyPortalFactory / PrivacyPortal / PodErc20MintableInitializable / PodErc20CotiMother · circled numbers refer to the flow legend
PrivacyPortalFactory (one per chain · Ownable OWNER of every pToken clone)
config: inbox · cotiChainId · cotiMotherContract · portal/pToken impls · priceOracle · nativeToken (WETH)
feeRecipient (immutable) · rescueRecipient · default fees (fixed | bps | max) · factory pause · blacklist
createPortal → clone portal + clone pToken + one-way registerToken to the mother
createPortalWithExistingPToken → remount an existing pToken on a fresh portal clone (minter rotates)
pToken forwarders (owner only): configurePToken · setPTokenMinter · setRequestKillMinAge · killStaleRequest
views read by portals: isAdmin / isOperator · depositsPaused / withdrawalsPaused · blacklisted · fees · oracle
admin-set USD prices (1e18 scale) per token
zero price ⇒ dynamic fee off (fixed fee only)
no MPC here: every move is a message to COTI
return legs: callback | app error | system error
garbled-circuit ops: onBoard · add/sub · gt/mux · offBoard · decrypt
balances exist only as garbled / ciphertext values
namespace = tokenId(sourceChainId, pToken) — derived ONLY from the
authenticated inbox origin (inboxMsgSender), never from arguments
registerToken(pToken, name, symbol, decimals) ← allow-listed factory only
success → respond(new ciphertexts, nonce) app failure → raise(reason)
per-token callback nonce starts at 1 on registration
executes the MpcMethodCall on the mother as (chainId, sender)
carries respond / raise back as the return leg
The mint is ASYNCHRONOUS. On deposit the portal locks the collateral NOW (safeTransferFrom), but the pTokens are
created LATER on COTI, and that leg can fail (inbox system error) or never settle. Something must remember who is owed what.
depositEscrows[mintRequestId] = { user, recipient, amount, status } is that memory:
• keyed by the pToken's request id → a refund is validated against pToken.requests(id).status (SystemFailed only)
• amount = MEASURED received (balance delta), so fee-on-transfer tokens refund exactly what arrived
• user ≠ recipient is allowed: pTokens go to `recipient`, a refund always goes back to `user`
• status Pending → Refunded makes any refund one-shot (no double refund); admin path needs pause + status ≠ Success
Without it the portal would hold a pile of collateral with no link to any depositor or to any failed request.
Known quirks: never marked terminal on mint SUCCESS (stays Pending forever) · DepositEscrowStatus.Failed is never written.
Deployer: factory.createPortal(underlying, …) — decimals must match the underlying (≤ 18)
Factory clones + initializes portal and pToken (pToken.minter = portal, pToken.owner = factory)
Factory sends a one-way registerToken to the mother — no error selector; the portal is already live (#5)
User: deposit / depositNative / wrap (lock collateral, escrow Pending) or requestWithdrawWithPermit (EIP-712)
Portal ↔ underlying: safeTransferFrom on deposit, safeTransfer / WETH.withdraw on release, rescue when paused
Portal → pToken: mint(recipient, received) · transferFromAndCallWithPermit(user → portal) · burn(amount)
pToken → inbox: sendTwoWayMessage(MpcMethodCall, callback = transferCallback, error = transferError, fee)
Source inbox → COTI inbox: miner relays the request (nonce-ordered per target chain)
COTI inbox → mother: mintPublic / transferOwnerPublic / burnPublic, authenticated as (chainId, pToken)
Mother ↔ MpcCore: onBoard → compute on garbled values → offBoard; never plaintext
Return leg: respond(ciphertexts) on success, raise(reason) on app failure; the inbox itself may emit a system error
Inbox → pToken: transferCallback (Success) or transferError (Failed / SystemFailed); terminal, one-way
pToken → portal: low-level call onPTokenTransferred(withdrawalId) → _releaseWithdrawal (withdrawals only; failure swallowed, #1)
Anyone: triggerWithdrawalRelease · refundFailedDeposit (needs SystemFailed) · finalizeBatchBurn · cancelFailedWithdrawal
Admin: pause/unpause · blacklist · setLimits · rescue* (paused) · burnAccumulatedPTokens · withdrawPortalFees → feeRecipient · remount
Operator: setDepositFee / setWithdrawFee / factory defaults (fixed | bps ≤ 10% | max) · setIsDepositEnabled
Portal → oracle (via factory): getLivePrices(native, underlying) for the dynamic fee floor; zero rate ⇒ fixed fee
